heading: Codes at run time
body:
A running page can get a code that does not start with `TY`. A client in `client/remotes` fails with an `HTTP_` code, `CANCELLED` or `DEADLINE`, and a native app answers a page with a `TY_NATIVE_` code. Your service code can read the code and show a message.

| Code | What it means | Read more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HTTP_REQUEST` | The request is not valid: larger than 64 KiB with its path, query, headers and body, a method or setting that the transport does not accept, or its deadline passed. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `HTTP_ORIGIN` | The request goes to another origin than the page, or the server answered with a redirect. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `HTTP_HEADER` | A header is not allowed: `Cookie`, `Host`, `Origin`, `Referer`, `Connection`, `Content-Length`, `Transfer-Encoding`, a name that starts with `Sec-` or `Proxy-`, a bad name or value, or more than 128 headers. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `HTTP_QUERY` | A query value is not text, a number or a boolean, it is too long, or the whole address is longer than 8 KiB. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `HTTP_BODY` | A `GET` or `HEAD` request has a body. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `HTTP_LIMIT` | The answer is larger than 1 MiB, or than the limit that the request set. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `HTTP_CAPACITY` | The page already has 64 requests waiting. Wait for one to finish. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `HTTP_STATUS` | The server answered with an error status. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `HTTP_RESPONSE` | The answer is not JSON or does not have the shape of the model, or a JSON value in the request or the answer is nested deeper than 32 levels or holds a number that JavaScript cannot keep exactly. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `HTTP_NETWORK` | The browser could not reach the server, or the request failed for another reason. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `HTTP_MISSING` | The client has no HTTP transport. The default transport runs only in the browser, so give the client an HTTP adapter in its Setup, for example in a test. | Calling the server from a page / Rust awaits a real Yon endpoint |
| `HTTP_ARGUMENT` | A request method got an argument that does not fit its place in the path, the query or the body. | Calling the server from a page / Client classes that call the server |
| `HTTP_PATH` | The path that a request method builds is not a safe path on the page's origin. | Calling the server from a page / Client classes that call the server |
| `CANCELLED` | The request was cancelled, for example because the component that started it was removed. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `DEADLINE` | The request did not finish within its deadline, at most 60 seconds. | Calling the server from a page / What the browser transport allows |
| `TY_NATIVE_SERVICE` | A page asked a native app for a service that the app does not have. | Rust, Go and C# in the browser / Services are compiled in |
| `TY_NATIVE_REQUIRED` | A native Swift or Kotlin service misses a property that it needs, or the page passed a value of the wrong type. | Rust, Go and C# in the browser / Services are compiled in |
| `TY_NATIVE_OWNER` | The page that asked is gone or was replaced, so the native app refuses the call. | Rust, Go and C# in the browser / Services are compiled in |
| `TY_NATIVE_ROUTE` | A call from the page to a native service did not say which page it came from. | Rust, Go and C# in the browser / Services are compiled in |
